subject: Evaluation request: Consolidate SDR sequencing platforms and procurement timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation request: Consolidate SDR sequencing platforms and procurement timeline

Hi team,

We need to kick off a short procurement review: Acme is asking us to consolidate SDR sequencing (Outreach + Salesloft usage across GTM) into a single vendor for cost, compliance, and standardization reasons. I pulled the current license/inventory and requirements into the attached docs (license_inventory_2027.xlsx, sequence_tool_rfp_requirements.pdf).

Key asks to start:
- Can we confirm current active seats by team and renewal dates? (see inventory)
- What are the compliance gaps (SOC2, data residency, SSO/KMS) vs. each vendor?
- Proposed target: a decision and PO trigger by end of May so Legal/Finance can process before June invoicing.

Ben — can you lead on cost estimates and ask Outreach for a consolidated enterprise quote?
Lauren — procurement checklist and required vendor docs (SOC2/ISO) would be great.
Sean — heads up since this will impact GTM onboarding flows and enablement.

Thanks,

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: license_inventory_2027.xlsx, sequence_tool_rfp_requirements.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, lydia@outreach.io
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation request: Consolidate SDR sequencing platforms and procurement timeline

Marissa / team,

Thanks — I pulled numbers from the CRM and our license portal. Quick summary:
- Outreach: 120 active seats (SDR + AE enablement). Renewal 09/2027.
- Salesloft: 45 seats (mostly EMEA SDRs) renewal 08/2027.
- HubSpot sequences (lightweight): used by 30 reps, no formal contract.

If we were to consolidate to Outreach enterprise seat pricing, rough sticker is $xxK/year for 165 seats, but I asked Lydia (cc'd) for an enterprise consolidation discount and a phased migration SOW.

Also flagged: Outreach holds some webhook/sequence data in their EU endpoint which may affect routing for APAC/EMEA. Need SOC2 and data processing agreement checked (Lauren).

Attaching a quick cost workbook (generated internally).

Ben
Director, Sales Ops
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: cost_scenario_2027.xlsx (internal)

From: Lydia Park <lydia@outreach.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Gupta <rajesh.g@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Outreach consolidated enterprise proposal for Acme / Redwood evaluation

Hi Ben, Marissa —

Thanks for looping me in. Attached is a preliminary Outreach Enterprise proposal for a consolidated seat purchase and a proposed migration SOW for phased data migration (Outreach <> Salesloft historical exports). We can support:
- Enterprise pricing tiers and multi-region hosting options
- SOC 2 Type II report (we'll share under NDA)
- SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning and optional KMS integration for customer-managed keys

Proposed demo and migration planning slots: May 18-20. Happy to run a technical deep-dive for you and Acme procurement.

Attachment: Outreach-Enterprise-proposal-Acme.pdf

Best,
Lydia Park
Enterprise Sales, Outreach
lydia@outreach.io

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@outreach.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outreach consolidated enterprise proposal for Acme / Redwood evaluation

Lydia — thanks for the quick response and the proposal. A few procurement items we need before we can move to PO:

1) SOC 2 Type II (scope + auditor) and most recent report — please provide via secure link/NDA.
2) Data Processing Addendum and confirmation of EU data residency options for EMEA customers.
3) Sample SOW for phased migration, including acceptance criteria for migrated sequences and historical activity.
4) A redline-friendly Master Subscription Agreement (MSA) and an initial quote broken down by seat type (SDR / AE / Manager) and any implementation fees.

I've attached our procurement_checklist.docx for your reference (internal). If Outreach can get those items to us by EOD May 16 we should be able to hit Marissa's timeline.

Lauren Bishop
Procurement Manager
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Attachment: procurement_checklist.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, lydia@outreach.io
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation request: Consolidate SDR sequencing platforms and procurement timeline

Quick note —

I'm supportive of consolidating for the following reasons:
- Single seat catalog simplifies enablement and reduces cross-tool churn.
- Expected ~12-18% unit cost savings with an enterprise consolidated commitment (pending Lydia's confirmation).
- Consolidation enables consistent analytics for funnel attribution.

If Outreach can't meet the compliance checklist or pricing parity we should also invite Salesloft and HubSpot Sales to provide competitive quotes — I'll coordinate that if needed.

Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: lydia@outreach.io, rajesh.g@acme.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation request: Consolidate SDR sequencing platforms and procurement timeline

Team — thanks for the fast turnaround. Current plan and next steps: 

1) Lydia: please send SOC2 link, DPA, MSA draft, and the broken-down quote by EOD May 18. We'll treat this as a binding quote for PO approval (Deal ID D-2027-045).
2) Lauren: if you don't receive the compliance artifacts by EOD 5/18, trigger competitive outreach to Salesloft/HubSpot and request their compliance packets + quotes with the same seat breakdown.
3) Ben: compile the cost comparison worksheet and produce a recommend/contingency column by EOD May 19.
4) Sean: review enablement impact and finalize the migration acceptance criteria with Lydia during the technical deep-dive.

I'll draft a short approval memo for Finance & Legal and link it back here once ready: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bSourcingScoring2027

Marissa

--
